brief.headline: Push LAMINATE from ₹385.00/KG down to ₹250.00/KG — the price Silk Polypack gives us and the fair market band — to save ₹22718 a year.

priceAsk.basis: Silk Polypack already gives us ₹250.00/KG — a 54.0% gap. The open-market fair band for pharma/ORS laminate is ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg), and import BOPET film runs 171.60 ₹/kg. UFLEX's ₹385.00/KG sits well above all these lines.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 60 Days After Receipt to 30 days in exchange for part of the price cut
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 30 days sooner frees up ₹5325 of cash for us, but offer it as a trade — we pay faster, they cut the price deeper.

brief.financialLeverage: UFLEX is huge (₹16492.00 Cr in sales) and we're tiny (₹64788 — 0.00% of their business), so on our own we have almost no pull. They're growing fast (35.5% a year) so they want new orders, and they owe a lot (1.25 times their own cash, total owed ₹10152.31 Cr) which means cash matters to them. They keep about ₹4 of every ₹100 they sell (4.1% profit), so the price cut will sting — but our real leverage is Silk Polypack's ₹250.00/KG price and the credible alternates we can name.

evidence.point: Silk Polypack gives us LAMINATE at ₹250.00/KG — 54.0% below UFLEX's ₹385.00/KG
Open-market asking price for pharma/ORS laminate is ₹205–305/kg, typically ₹250/kg — UFLEX is above fair
evidence.figure: askBand ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg, verdict MARKET-FAIR (top of fair band)

evidence.point: BOPET film import benchmark is 171.60 ₹/kg — the raw material costs far less than UFLEX's finished price
UFLEX owes 1.25 times their own cash (₹10152.31 Cr total debt) — they value fast payment
They're growing fast (35.5% a year) so they need new orders to fill that capacity
We're 0.00% of their ₹16492.00 Cr revenue — almost invisible to them

alternates.name: Silk Polypack
alternates.why: Already supplies us LAMINATE at ₹250.00/KG — proven quality, proven price, ready to scale.

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed converter (₹2755.75 Cr revenue, health C 58/100), already a tiny FDC supplier — a scalable second source for laminate sachets.

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India arm (₹222.04 Cr revenue, health D 31/100) doing pharma blister and sachet laminates — credible alternate for GEEP.

risks: We're 0.00% of their sales — bundle more SKUs or commit multi-year volume to get attention.
They owe 1.25 times their own cash — watch supply continuity, but don't squeeze so hard that cash trouble spills into delivery delays.
Silk Polypack at ₹250.00/KG is our best price reference, but qualify Huhtamaki or Constantia Parikh with samples and audits before you threaten to walk — we need a proven backup, not just a name.
UFLEX keeps only 4.1% profit — a 54.0% price cut will hurt them, so expect pushback; be ready to split the gap or offer faster payment (30 days) as a sweetener.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're paying you ₹385 a kilo for LAMINATE, but Silk Polypack gives us the same thing at ₹250 — and that sits right in the fair market band — so let's talk about how we close that 54% gap.
